boards.note: $100 matched per Change.org signature · up to $1 million · capital gift in Darren’s honor
boards.funder: We are no longer moving forward with the billboards. A Ram alum still matches $100 for every Change.org signature, up to $1 million — and those funds will now be donated in honor of Darren Mullis toward Holy Rosary’s capital improvement campaign. We continue collecting signatures for the petition. This is not a donation through Change.org.
